Kennel cleaning and some practical advice
The desk is glad to help later this week
Companion Animal Travel Desk notice

Travelers should check their pet travel plans early and keep the kennel clean, snug, and ready for boarding. A tidy space helps your animal stay calmer, and it also makes the handoff easier for crews and ground staff.

Please bring the usual travel papers, water, and any comfort item that is allowed. If your pet is sensitive to noise or busy spaces, let the desk know in advance so we can guide you toward the smoothest process. <<FACT F002>> Keep all carrier locks secure and make sure the label on the kennel is easy to read.

For travelers passing through other skyports, good planning helps avoid stress on the day of travel. <<FACT F010>> Short checks before departure can prevent delays, and our team is happy to walk you through the practical steps in plain language.

If you need help, please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
